snippet.title: Bandwagon - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Sign up to playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555740/Bandwagon/

In this survivors-lite adventure you'll play as brave little Drumbo, marching to the beat of your own drum. Assemble a band of animal instrumentalists as you explore an open world where each day brings new surprises.

🥁 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/AxYpX7AaFP
🎷 Follow us on  Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/bippinbits.bsky.social
🪈 Follow us on X: https://x.com/Bippinbits
🎹 Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@bandwagongame
